definitions.explanation: Speaking aloud to oneself without addressing anyone, often while thinking or working.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{独|ひと}り{言|ごと}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: He talks to himself a lot.

examples.japanese: 「{困|こま}ったな」と{独|ひと}り{言|ごと}を{言|い}った。
examples.english: "This is a problem," I muttered to myself.

examples.japanese: {独|ひと}り{言|ごと}のつもりが、{聞|き}かれていた。
examples.english: I thought I was talking to myself, but someone heard me.

examples.japanese: {隣|となり}の{席|せき}の{人|ひと}がぶつぶつと{独|ひと}り{言|ごと}を{言|い}っていて{気|き}になった。
examples.english: The person sitting next to me was mumbling to themselves, and it bothered me.

examples.japanese: {難|むずか}しい{問題|もんだい}を{考|かんが}えている{時|とき}、つい{独|ひと}り{言|ごと}が{出|で}てしまう。
examples.english: When I'm thinking about a difficult problem, I end up talking to myself without realizing it.

notes:
{独|ひと}り{言|ごと} is speaking aloud to oneself, often unconsciously while thinking or working through a problem.

FORMATION: {独|ひと}り (alone) + {言|ごと} (speech/saying)

KANJI VARIANTS:
- {独|ひと}り{言|ごと}: standard writing
- ひとりごと: often written in hiragana
- {独言|ひとりごと}: compact kanji form (less common)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {独|ひと}り{言|ごと}を{言|い}う: to talk to oneself
- {独|ひと}り{言|ごと}が{多|おお}い: to talk to oneself a lot
- {独|ひと}り{言|ごと}のように: as if talking to oneself
- ぶつぶつと{独|ひと}り{言|ごと}: mumbling to oneself

RELATED ～{言|ごと} WORDS:
- {寝言|ねごと}: sleep-talking
- たわ{言|ごと}: nonsense, drivel
- {泣|な}き{言|ごと}: whining, complaining
